name: Chocolate Mousse Cake
description: A no-bake cake of ladyfingers layered with rich semisweet chocolate mousse in a springform pan, chilled until set.

recipeInstructions.name: Line the pan
recipeInstructions.text: Line the bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan with split ladyfingers (from 3 packages), placing the cookies close together.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the chocolate base
recipeInstructions.text: Cook 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup whipping cream and 1/4 cup butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, 5 to 7 minutes or until the sugar dissolves. Add 18 ounces coarsely chopped semisweet chocolate, 1 teaspoon vanilla and, if desired, 2 tablespoons hazelnut liqueur, stirring until the chocolate melts. Remove from the heat and cool slightly.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold in whipped cream
recipeInstructions.text: Fold 2 cups whipped whipping cream into the chocolate mixture.

recipeInstructions.name: Layer
recipeInstructions.text: Pour one-third of the mixture into the prepared pan and top with half of the remaining ladyfingers. Repeat the layers, ending with the chocolate mixture.

recipeInstructions.name: Chill
recipeInstructions.text: Chill at least 4 hours. Carefully remove the sides of the springform pan. Garnish with chocolate leaves, if desired.
Make ahead: cover and freeze up to 1 month, then thaw in the refrigerator 8 hours.
Chocolate: Ghirardelli semisweet chocolate squares were used.
